local_context.value: Mount Pleasant is in Charleston County. 2020 census: 18.0% of residents were 65 or older (median age 41.6); 40,680 housing units (8.6% vacant). "Mount Pleasant was hit by Hurricane Hugo, a Category Four hurricane" in 1989. Old Village is the oldest neighborhood.

place_entities.value: Boone Hall Plantation; Patriots Point; Arthur Ravenel Jr. Bridge (2005); Palmetto Islands County Park; Mount Pleasant Pier

permit_office.value: Town of Mount Pleasant Building Inspection Division (Engineering & Development Services), 100 Ann Edwards Lane; building permits above the Building Official's valuation threshold or needing structural inspection "must obtain a building permit"; trade permits issued by Front Office staff.
